messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: semTools: cfa.mi lavaan doesn't run.
parts:
This is a semTools question, but...
I am trying to run a little demo for my class. I simulated data on six variables with NA replacing missing values (attached in binary form as missdata.bin), and a two-factor model:

missmodel<-'
f1=~y1+y2+y3
f2=~y4+y5+y6
'

But when I run cfa.mi, I get:

> mi.out<-runMI(model=missmodel,data = missdata,miPackage="Amelia",chi="all",m=5,fun="cfa")
> summary(mi.out)
** WARNING ** lavaan (0.5-23.1097) model has NOT been fitted
** WARNING ** Estimates below are simply the starting values

And I get a chi-square and parameter estimates but no standard errors.

Can someone spot what I'm doing wrong?

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: semTools: cfa.mi lavaan doesn't run.
parts: Might be. I am still at lavaan version 0.5-23.1097. Thanks.

Hi Ed,

Mauricio is right, it is a version issue.  Is the latest version working for you?

install.packages("lavaan", repos="http://www.da.ugent.be", type="source")

# install.packages("devtools") # if necessary, for the next line of syntax to work
devtools::install_github("simsem/semTools/semTools")

There have been big internal changes to runMI(), so see the help page for new (and deleted) arguments, as well as the class?lavaan.mi help page for new methods.  And please let me know if something still doesn't work right, so I can fix it.

Thanks,

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Postdoctoral Researcher, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
UvA web page: http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen
